about: Every change to the MKC CRM (mkc-crm/index.html and its server functions in api/), oldest first. Entries before 2.44.0 come from the commit history in this repository; the first entry summarises what the CRM already had when that history begins. Add an entry for every change; see CLAUDE.md.

fields.date: the day the change went live (YYYY-MM-DD)
fields.audience: who it applies to: everyone | admin (Admins and Super Admins) | super (Super Admins only)
fields.announce: true to show it in the What's new pop-up the next time each person it applies to signs in
fields.slides: ids of tour slides (GUIDE_STEPS in index.html) whose pictures illustrate it

entries.title: The CRM when this log begins
entries.summary: What the CRM already did before the history kept in this repository starts. Earlier changes were not recorded here.
details: Sign-in with MKC ID and workspace passcode; three access levels (Staff see only what is assigned to them; Admin and Super Admin see everything).
Leads, Pipeline, Contacts and Accounts from ClickUp, as lists, Kanban boards or a calendar, with search, filters, sorting and the staleness indicator.
Dashboard, My Day and My Work.
Record panel with Details, CRM Actions, Activity, Related and Tasks; Log New Activity; Edit Record; Catch Up summaries; Closed/Won and Closed/Lost logging.
CRM Actions: AI-drafted messages from templates, sent as the team member by text (Quo) or email, with Schedule Send and the Outbox.
Activity Inbox for calls and texts, with Smart Triage and Quick Capture.
Action Hub (Master CRM Tasks), bulk assign and archive, Export, Resources.
Settings for admins: Team Management, Message Templates (edited by Super Admins), Data Maintenance (Super Admins), connection status and integrations.

entries.title: Drafts use the name people go by
entries.summary: Drafted messages greet people by their Known As name when they have one, instead of their first name.

entries.title: Archived deals out of the way
entries.summary: Archived deals are hidden from the Pipeline by default, with a switch to show them.

entries.title: Follow Up Based on Last Activity
entries.summary: A new CRM Action that drafts a follow-up from the record's recent history, loading as much history as you choose.

entries.title: Second phone and email, checked before saving
entries.summary: Leads and contacts gain Phone 2 and Email 2 in Edit Record and Details; phone numbers are saved in the format ClickUp expects and email addresses are checked before saving.

entries.title: Add to Google Calendar
entries.summary: + Task and Log activity can add the event to Google Calendar with a pre-filled link (no Google sign-in needed), optionally inviting the client.
details: Opens from a button you tap, so phone browsers don't block it.
Uses the task's start date; explains what's missing when there's no date.

entries.title: Smart Triage shows what it logged
entries.summary: After confirming in bulk, Smart Triage lists the records it logged to, each one tap away.

entries.title: New leads from the inbox keep their message
entries.summary: Creating a lead or contact from an Activity Inbox message now also links that message to the new record.

entries.title: Follow-up message straight after assigning
entries.summary: After assigning an inbox item, Create Follow-Up Message opens the record with its recent activity loaded. Write Custom Message can use recent activity too.

entries.title: Field changes no longer fail silently
entries.summary: Phone numbers and other fields that sometimes didn't save now save, and when ClickUp refuses a change the CRM says so.
details: Applies to new entries, Edit Record, team members, Closed/Won and task links.
Tasks and activities link to their lead, contact or account reliably.

entries.title: Second phone and email on New Entry
entries.summary: New Entry asks for Phone 2 and Email 2; team members' phone numbers and emails, including their sign-in email, are checked.
details: The Related Account backfill tool now writes to the right field and reports real errors (Super Admins).

entries.title: CRM Dictation Reader
entries.summary: Paste dictated notes or a recap in Settings and the reader turns them into new records, activities, tasks and comments, each previewed and editable before saving.
details: When a first name matches several people, it shows them all instead of guessing.

entries.title: Activity Inbox recognises more phone numbers
entries.summary: Calls and texts are matched to records whatever format the phone number was saved in.

entries.title: Bookings arrive in the CRM
entries.summary: A booking made on start.befortune5.com finds or creates the person's lead and logs the booking on their record. The booking system reads the team from the Team Directory.
details: Server functions /api/booking-created and /api/team-directory, protected by the shared secret.

entries.title: AI and sending locked to signed-in team members
entries.summary: The AI drafting and message-sending functions now only answer the CRM's own server, which checks the person is signed in. The ClickUp key was removed from the page.
details: Before this, anyone who knew the addresses could use the AI or send texts and emails from MKC's number and domain.
File attachments go through the CRM's server too.

entries.title: 22 fixes from a full check of the CRM
entries.summary: Search boxes keep focus while you type, names with apostrophes no longer break buttons, sends and closes can't be doubled by a second tap, and more.
details: Records open with the right type from the Action Hub and boards.
Quick Capture times no longer shift by the time zone; it asks before throwing away typed text.
Refresh says which lists failed instead of quietly showing old data; an expired session resets cleanly.
Phones: calendar fits, no zooming into inputs, task names wrap.
Archive's Cancel no longer archives.

entries.title: MKC look and clearer lists
entries.summary: MKC colours and the Montserrat font, the hub logo in colour, and tidier lists, filters and boards.
details: Lists show the name first with the MKC ID under it, and a coloured dot for when the record was last touched.
Filters say what they do (All branches, Any follow-up, Sort: default).
Dashboard cards open their list; visible keyboard focus everywhere.

entries.title: Add to Frontrow
entries.summary: On a contact or account, Add to Frontrow opens Frontrow Manager to give the client their portal sign-in.

entries.title: Today
entries.summary: The dashboard opens with what needs you: overdue and due tasks, follow-ups that are due, messages waiting for your OK and records going stale.
details: Needs Follow-Up became Team follow-up.

entries.title: Command bar
entries.summary: Ctrl K (⌘K on a Mac), / or the search box finds any record and goes to any screen, with your recent records first.

entries.title: Record header and quick actions
entries.summary: Each record shows its owner, last touched, next action and status at the top, with Log activity, + Task, Message, Call and Add to Frontrow underneath.

entries.title: Built for phones
entries.summary: A bottom bar (Today, Leads, +, Pipeline, More), lists as cards, and filters folded behind one button.

entries.title: Completed jobs and invoices
entries.summary: Log job records each finished job as a won deal with its amount, date of service and invoice status; Today totals what's unpaid.
details: Invoice status (Pending, Sent, Paid, Overdue) can be changed in place on the deal, or with Mark paid.
Optional "send invoice" task; Save & add another for entering past jobs.
Pipeline shows amounts and has an Unpaid filter; accounts show what's owed.

entries.title: The assistant
entries.summary: Say or type what happened. The assistant drafts the changes, asks only for what's missing, reads them back, and saves nothing until you confirm.
details: Voice in Chrome, Edge and Safari; typing everywhere.

entries.title: List filters combine and stay put
entries.summary: Choosing a branch no longer clears the status filter, and filters survive the 5-minute refresh. Boards follow the filters too.

entries.title: Statuses match ClickUp
entries.summary: Status menus and board columns come from ClickUp itself, so new deals save and every deal shows in its stage. Unpaid totals count the remaining balance after a deposit.
details: ClickUp had renamed "Oppurtunity" to "opportunity" and changed the Contacts and Accounts statuses.

entries.title: Every brand form feeds the CRM
entries.summary: Bookings, discovery and start forms, brand briefs, contact forms, sign-ups and design requests on the JTG sites find or create the lead, fill in their details, note what they did, and tag them in Systeme.io.
details: Existing details are never overwritten; labels are added to, not replaced.
Leads have no Company field, so the company is written in the activity note.

entries.title: Files in the activity feed
entries.summary: A record's Activity tab now shows files uploaded to it and files posted in comments, with picture previews, not just notes.
details: Files you attach when logging an activity appear straight away.

entries.title: Picture tour
entries.summary: A slide-by-slide tour with screenshots of every feature, for your access level. Replay it from Resources, the ? button or by searching "tour".
details: Its screenshots are retaken automatically whenever the CRM changes.

entries.title: Email sends from the right account
entries.summary: Emails go out as you through the Resend account that holds your email's domain. If your domain isn't set up yet, the CRM says so instead of failing.
details: Domains per account are listed in api/_lib/senders.ts.

entries.title: Phone filters no longer squash search
entries.summary: On a phone, opening a list's filters keeps the search box full width.

entries.title: Only Super Admins grant Admin access
entries.summary: When adding a team member, only a Super Admin can choose Admin or Super Admin.

entries.title: Change log
entries.summary: Admins have a Change Log page with every change to the CRM, oldest to newest, which can be searched, filtered and downloaded.
details: Download as JSON or CSV to keep a copy.

entries.title: What's new, after each update
entries.summary: The first time you sign in after an update, a short summary shows what changed for you. Find it again under Resources.

entries.title: New address: jtg-tools.mkcworkspace.com
entries.summary: The CRM now lives at jtg-tools.mkcworkspace.com/mkc-crm/ (jtg-tools.mkcworkspace.com/crm takes you there too). The old jtgworkspace.com address is switched off, so update your bookmarks and sign in once on the new address.
details: Frontrow moved too: frontrow.mkcworkspace.com for clients and frontrow-manager.mkcworkspace.com for the team. Add to Frontrow on a record opens the new Frontrow Manager address.
Emails still go out as you, from your own MKC address. mkcworkspace.com replaces jtgworkspace.com as a sending domain.
